en.title: Six young male students at Sigtunaskolan charged
en.summary: Six young male students have been charged with offences at Sigtunaskolan Humanistiska Läroverket. All are in the third year of upper secondary school. Three of them are charged with aggravated sexual harassment, aggravated assault and aggravated unlawful coercion, and the case also covers several cases of assault and unlawful coercion.

sv.title: Volvo döms att betala 23 miljoner kronor – efter allvarlig olycka
sv.summary: En anställd på Volvo Personvagnar AB i Olofström höll på att klämmas ihjäl i en olycka förra året. Nu döms Volvo att betala 23,2 miljoner kronor i företagsbot, då det framkommit stora säkerhetsbrister i fabriken.

en.title: Volvo ordered to pay SEK 23 million – after serious accident
en.summary: An employee at Volvo Personvagnar AB in Olofström was nearly crushed to death in an accident last year. Volvo is now sentenced to pay SEK 23.2 million in corporate fine, as serious safety deficiencies in the factory have emerged.

sv.title: Nättrafiken ökade 35 procent vid GTA-släppet

en.title: Internet traffic rose 35 percent at GTA release
en.summary: Swedish internet traffic rose 35 percent at midnight when the long-awaited game "GTA VI" was released, according to fibre provider Global Connect.

sv.title: NCAB bommade tidigare mål – sätter nya
sv.summary: Mönsterkorttillverkaren NCAB lanserar nya mål inför torsdagens kapitalmarknadsdag. Detta efter att ha bommat de tidigare målen – med råge. Bolaget luddar också till sin utdelningspolicy.

en.title: NCAB missed earlier targets – sets new ones
en.summary: Circuit board manufacturer NCAB is launching new targets ahead of Thursday's capital markets day. This follows missing the previous targets – by a wide margin. The company is also fudging its dividend policy.

sv.title: Gråhandeln visar: Anthropic ser ut att rusa i börsdebuten
sv.summary: På torsdagen gör AI-jätten Anthropic börsdebut i New York. Om man ska tro gråhandeln kommer bolaget att få en drömstart – på flera plattformar indikeras en kursuppgång på över 20 procent.

en.title: Grey market signals: Anthropic looks set for a strong stock market debut
en.summary: On Thursday, AI giant Anthropic makes its stock market debut in New York. If the grey market is to be believed, the company will get a dream start – several platforms indicate a share price rise of over 20 percent.

sv.title: Stötande att vänstern stoppar äldres valfrihet
sv.summary: I Stockholm kommer S, MP och V skrota valfriheten inom hemtjänsten och fasa ut privata alternativ. Det kommer göra det svårare att byta om man inte känner sig nöjd.

en.title: Outrageous that the left is cutting elderly people's freedom of choice
en.summary: In Stockholm, the Social Democrats (S), the Green Party (MP) and the Left Party (V) will scrap freedom of choice in home care and phase out private alternatives. It will make it harder to switch if you are not satisfied.

sv.title: Resultattapp för Sensys Gatso
sv.summary: Sensys Gatso, som utvecklar system för trafiksäkerhet och trafikinformatik, redovisar ett rörelseresultat på 6,0 miljoner kronor för det tredje kvartalet 2026, ett tapp från 16,4 miljoner i fjol.

en.title: Sensys Gatso profit drops
en.summary: Sensys Gatso, which develops road safety and traffic information systems, reports an operating profit of SEK 6.0 million for the third quarter of 2026, down from SEK 16.4 million last year.

sv.title: Norwegian inleder samarbete inom syntetiskt flygbränsle

en.title: Norwegian launches synthetic aviation fuel partnership
en.summary: Airline Norwegian is launching a strategic partnership with European Energy and Swiss company Metafuels to develop production of synthetic aviation fuel, e-SAF, in Denmark. This is according to a press release.

en.title: Foreign minister worried about great powers wanting to rule the world
en.summary: The summit meeting of the leaders of the USA, China and Russia has worried some in Europe – it has been described as the leaders of the world's great powers meeting to create a new world order.

en.title: Expert: Myanmar ruling may give clues on genocide case against Israel
en.summary: After seven years, the ICJ's decision in the genocide case against Myanmar is coming. The outcome on Thursday may also be significant for the case against Israel. "This will possibly make it somewhat easier or harder for South Africa," says international law professor Mark Klamberg.

en.title: VNV launches fund – to invest in tech companies in growth markets

en.title: From "mor och far" to "mamma och pappa" – how family language has changed
en.summary: What we call our parents has shifted over time, between generations and between different parts of the country. But whether a child says "mamma och pappa" or uses first names matters little for the relationship, according to psychologist Katarina Blom.
